_comment: Our scorer spec ids -> the ElliotWood/Forever simulator's spec folder (ui/specs/<class>/<spec>), gear preset, rotation (APL), player options (protojson fragment of the Player spec oneof), consumables and race, all taken from that folder's presets.ts on 2026-09-26. `builds` are our proposed-builds.json ids raced by default; the sim's own preset talents are added automatically. buffs_off / debuffs_off: proto field names of the sim's full buff set that the spec itself provides through a talent (Trueshot Aura, Leader of the Pack, Moonkin Aura); the bench clears them so the talent's own value is measured instead of duplicated.

frost-raid.rotation_note: Base rotation (2026-09-28): the simulator's `frost.apl.json` plus Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc, guarded by `auraIsKnown` so only builds with Missile Barrage cast it. The simulator's Frost rotation never casts Arcane Missiles, which cost the Arcane Power Frost draft (the one Frost build with Missile Barrage) 13% on the training dummy (484.8 -> 548.0 DPS) and 10% in the raid setting; the Fingers of Frost and Winter's Chill builds are unchanged. The rotation search also tunes on that draft (`tune_builds`).

arcane-dps.rotation_note: Rotation-only target (2026-09-27): a talent tree none of our scorer spec models covers. The rotation search tunes its rotation on the simulator's own builds for the tree (preset_names) or ours when listed; no talent calibration or optimizer runs.

frostfire-raid.rotation_note: Frostfire Bolt mage (2026-09-28, new-builds survey): a Fire/Frost hybrid built on Frostfire Bolt, which counts as both schools. The community simulator ships Frostfire Bolt as a stub: this target runs on our implementation of it (_reference/data/raidsim/patches/), so its numbers are our model of the beta, not the community's.

incinerate-raid.rotation_note: Incinerate warlock (2026-09-28, new-builds survey): Incinerate, the Forever Destruction capstone cast by none of the simulator's warlock rotations, as the filler (+25% on an Immolated target) with Immolate kept up and Conflagrate while it burns. Kept as that untuned rotation: the rotation search on destruction-incinerate-raid (2026-09-28) inserted Shadow Bolt ahead of Incinerate in its first round, on the training dummy and in a raid, so a tuned rotation here would no longer be an Incinerate rotation.

mm-raid.self_note: Training dummy (2026-09-27): the main runs of the Forever DPS specs use a boss-level dummy with only your own buffs: what the class code adds itself (talent auras, Arcane Brilliance, the priest buffs, the shout, curse, totems and imbues in the rotation), the spec's standard consumables, and self_buffs / self_debuffs: buffs this class casts on itself that the simulator only has as raid switches.
mm-raid.rotation_note: Arcane Shot (2026-09-29): no rotation had cast it (the rotation search only offered new Forever spells and cooldowns); inserted where it won (+4.8% dummy, +16.8% raid, bm-mm and lone-wolf builds, two independent seeds). The Summon Hawk builds share its timer with the hawk and gain nothing.

melee-dps.rotation_note: Melee hunter (2026-09-27): our melee builds on our own base rotation and a dual-wield version of the hunter's phase-1 gear (Deathbringer and Brutality Blade with Crusader). The simulator models only Aspect of the Hawk; our patch adds Aspect of the Beast (below). The scorer's melee model is not calibrated to these numbers. Traps (2026-09-29, user request): Immolation Trap then Explosive Trap as the last lines of both rotations, cast in combat under the target. No rotation had cast them (the search pools only insert new Forever spells and cooldowns). The simulator gives all traps one shared 30 s cooldown (its author's reading of the demo streams; the beta tooltips say only '30 sec cooldown' and 'only one Fire trap can be active'): with it, +7.7% on the dummy and +3.8% in the raid (Immolation alone; Explosive is then never cast); with separate cooldowns (a temporary patch, not kept) +12.6% and +6.4%. The user's reading (2026-09-29): fire traps share a cooldown with each other and frost traps with each other, so the shared-cooldown numbers apply (Immolation every 30 s; the Explosive line stays for packs). The simulator puts the frost traps on the same timer too, which no rotation here casts. Aspect of the Beast (2026-09-29): our simulator patch (patches/forever/sim/hunter/aspect_of_the_beast.go) adds Aspect of the Beast (+110 melee attack power) and the melee half of Deadly Aspects (10% per melee auto attack, +30% melee speed for 12 s); both rotations open with it: +12.3% dummy, +12.9% raid. Melee hunter numbers from that date rest on this patch (our model).

not_measured.Murder: +4% against Humanoid and Giant targets only (beta tooltip); the simulator's standard target is neither, so the removal run reads 0. Raid value = 30% of the bonus (assumed share of raid boss fights against those types: Zul'Gurub's trolls, several Molten Core and AQ40 bosses; not Blackwing Lair's dragonkin or Naxxramas's undead).

arms-battle-raid.rotation_note: Arms in Battle Stance (2026-09-29, the overnight audit): the warrior rotations never left Berserker Stance, so Overpower and Rend (Battle Stance abilities; Forever's Bloodthrill makes Rend open Overpower) were never cast. Our base: the arms-2h-raid rotation with Battle Stance instead of Berserker Stance, Overpower and Rend (only when not ticking) after Mortal Strike, Slam before the shout. With the simulator's Arms 39/12/0 preset: 167 -> 198 dummy DPS, 377 -> 454 raid.

ret-dps.numbers_note: Retribution's equal-tier set (raidsim/gear_opt.py, 2026-09-30) is caster gear: the simulator's stat weights value spell damage more than Strength for this spec, and the set leans on Forever launch items (Leafre's Ring of Precise Spell Power, +100 spell damage). In a full raid it also gains from both the physical and the spell buffs, and in Forever Curse of the Elements covers Holy (beta tooltip: 'Magic damage taken'). Check the launch items' availability before trusting the full-raid number.
